title: NRW.Bank website taken offline after hacker attack on IT provider Planet IC, dpa-AFX reports
date_note: The dpa-AFX report (26 November) gives no earlier day for the website shutdown; Planet IC says hackers entered its system the previous Saturday.
summary: According to dpa-AFX, NRW.Bank took its website offline as a precaution after a hacker attack on its IT service provider Planet IC in Schwerin; a replacement page is online and customer portals remain accessible. NRW.Bank says there are no indications it is affected. Planet IC says it has informed the Mecklenburg-Vorpommern state criminal police, the state data protection commissioner and the BSI, and is restoring systems step by step.
plain: The development bank NRW.Bank switched off its website as a precaution after its IT provider Planet IC was hacked. The bank says there are no indications it is affected; customer portals still work, dpa-AFX reports.
exec: A hack at an IT provider forced a public development bank to take its website offline; customer portals remain accessible, dpa-AFX reports.
geo_basis: NRW.Bank headquarters city is CyberView's assumption; the page does not state a location

validation.note: One publisher (dpa-AFX via finanzen.net) quoting NRW.Bank and Planet IC statements; azonline.de carries the same headline but could not be read.

review.note: Compared title, date, Planet IC Saturday, LKA/BSI, portals, no-indications statement against both dpa-AFX pages
